metadata.name: WIRED: Unrevealed
metadata.description:
Some things stay with you long after the noise fades.
WIRED is a collection of 999 animated cat PFPs inspired by Basement guitarist and artist Alex Henery’s artwork for the band’s WIRED album.
Basement is one of my favorite bands. This collection began with that connection, then grew into a world of its own as an independent tribute to the music and art that sparked it. A feline spirit waiting to emerge. Eclipse is the shared unrevealed artwork; the final cat and traits will be assigned at reveal.
